items.title: Uncovering Cellular Resolution in scRNAseq via Unbiased Cell and Gene Network Analysis
items.title_zh: 通过无偏细胞和基因网络分析揭示scRNAseq中的细胞分辨率
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据的常规注释严重依赖手动、基于标记的阈值设定，这种方法可能掩盖细微的转录梯度，并将功能不同的细胞状态合并为广泛异质群体。这里我们将高斯多图模型（GmGM）框架应用于10x Genomics PBMC数据集，该框架从单个scRNA-seq数据矩阵联合推断细胞-细胞和基因-基因依赖结构。十次独立的GMGM-Leiden聚类运行通过软聚类集成方法整合为稳健的共识分区，并与参考细胞类型注释进行基准比较。该策略产生稳定的聚类分区，能解析参考注释未区分的生物学意义亚群。同时，对每个聚类，通过跨分辨率共识Leiden聚类从拟合模型中提取基因共表达模块，使用标准网络指标评估，并通过网络富集分析测试（NEAT）进行功能验证，确认非随机富集信号。模块评分程序将网络拓扑与每细胞、每聚类表达特征联系起来，并展示了GmGM的新扩展，在单次模型运行中恢复共享细胞-细胞网络和群体

extra.description: Conventional annotation of single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data relies heavily on manual, marker-based thresholding, an approach that can obscure subtle transcriptomic gradients and collapse functionally distinct cell states into broad, heterogeneous populations. Here we apply the Gaussian multi-Graphical Model (GmGM) framework, which jointly infers cell-cell and gene-gene dependency structure from a single scRNA-seq data matrix, to a 10x Genomics PBMC dataset. Ten independent GMGM-Leiden clustering runs were integrated into a robust consensus partition using a soft cluster ensemble approach and benchmarked against reference cell-type annotations. This strategy yielded stable cluster partitions that resolve biologically meaningful sub-populations not distinguished by the reference annotation. In parallel, for each cluster, gene co-expression modules were extracted from the fitted model via consensus Leiden clustering across resolutions, evaluated using standard network metrics, and validated functionally with the Network Enrichment Analysis Test (NEAT), which confirmed non-random enrichment signal. A module-scoring procedure linked network topology to per-cell, per-cluster expression signatures, and a novel extension of GmGM, recovering a shared cell-cell network together with population-specific gene networks in a single model run, was demonstrated in a case study on the CD4+ T-cell population. These results indicate that GmGM provides a unified, reproducible framework for joint cell clustering and gene-network inference, capable of revealing cellular structure beyond that captured by conventional pipelines.

items.title: Fragment Path Complex Networks for Viral Genome Classification
items.title_zh: 用于病毒基因组分类的片段路径复形网络
items.summary_zh: 病毒科的准确分类对于理解基因组多样性至关重要，但快速进化和异质基因组结构使可靠归属变得复杂。新发现的病毒，尤其是来自代表性不足生态系统的病毒，扩展了病毒基因组的已知多样性。这种不断增长的多样性对依赖与现有参考相似性的分类方法构成挑战。我们提出片段路径复形网络（FPCN），一个将病毒基因组表示为不同尺度有序片段序列的框架。FPCN捕捉每个片段内的上下文序列信息，并使用路径复形建模相邻片段之间的复杂关系。我们在成熟的NCBI基准上评估FPCN，FPCN取得了高于竞争方法的分类准确率。对新发布数据集的进一步评估显示，FPCN能够泛化到训练中未出现的基因组。总之，这些结果使FPCN成为在基准数据集和新发布基因组中对已知科内病毒基因组进行分类的有效工具。

extra.description: Accurate classification of viral families is essential to understanding genomic diversity, but rapid evolution and heterogeneous genome structure complicate reliable assignment. Newly discovered viruses, particularly those from underrepresented ecosystems, expand the known diversity of viral genomes. This growing diversity poses challenges for classification methods that rely on similarity to existing references. We present Fragment Path Complex Networks (FPCN), a framework that represents viral genomes as sequences of ordered fragments at various scales. FPCN captures contextual sequence information within each fragment and uses path complexes to model complex relationships between neighboring fragments. We evaluated FPCN on well-established NCBI benchmarks, and FPCN achieved higher classification accuracy than competing methods. Further evaluations on newly released datasets revealed FPCN's ability to generalize to genomes that were not presented in the training. Together, these results position FPCN as an effective tool for classifying viral genomes within known families across benchmark datasets and newly released genomes.

items.title: From Imbalance to Evidence: Deep Nonparametric Testing for Complex Data under Severe Sample Imbalance
items.title_zh: 从失衡到证据：严重样本失衡下复杂数据的深度非参数检验
items.summary_zh: 在严重样本不平衡下比较分布，需要有效利用大量多数类观测，同时保持对较小样本相关差异的敏感性。这一挑战对复杂非欧几里得数据尤其重要，例如图数据，其结构特征需要灵活的检验方法。分类器双样本检验（C2STs）提供了这种灵活性，但现有方法主要针对平衡或规模相近的样本设计。本文研究高度不平衡情形下的C2STs，并表明严重样本不平衡可能显著降低检验性能。不同于传统不平衡学习仅将样本不平衡视为分类器训练的干扰，我们将其转化为重复检验证据的来源。基于这一洞见，我们提出增强型不平衡感知深度分类器双样本检验（EIAD-C2ST），这是一个与分类器无关、面向样本不平衡的框架，通过针对数据结构定制分类器来适配多种数据模态。对于计算代价高昂的深度分类器，我们进一步提出可扩展的表示摊销实现策略。理论上，我们建立了渐近 size 的严格保证，并刻画了功效一致性的条件，允许不平衡比发散。我们通过模拟和区块链取证应用展示了

extra.description: Comparing distributions under severe sample imbalance requires effectively using abundant majority observations while retaining sensitivity to differences involving the smaller sample. This challenge is particularly relevant for complex, non-Euclidean data, such as graphs, whose structural characteristics call for flexible testing procedures. Classifier two-sample tests (C2STs) provide such flexibility, but existing procedures are primarily designed for balanced or comparably sized samples. In this paper, we study C2STs in a highly imbalanced regime, and show that severe sample imbalance may substantially degrade testing performance. Different from conventional imbalanced learning approaches that treat sample imbalance merely as a nuisance for classifier training, we turn it into a source of repeated testing evidence. Building on this insight, we propose an Enhanced Imbalance-Aware Deep Classifier Two-Sample Test (EIAD-C2ST), a classifier-agnostic framework designed for sample imbalance that accommodates diverse data modalities by tailoring classifiers to data structure. For computationally expensive deep classifiers, we further develop a scalable representation-amortized implementation strategy. Theoretically, we establish rigorous guarantees on asymptotic size and characterize conditions for power consistency, allowing the imbalance ratio to diverge. We demonstrate the empirical gains using simulations and an application to blockchain forensics. The results reveal that the majority-sample surplus, when properly leveraged, can be organized into useful statistical evidence, rather than an obstacle, for distributional comparisons with complex data.

items.title: PhySeqNet: physics-informed fluorescent foci detection for BARseq spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: PhySeqNet：用于BARseq空间转录组学的物理信息荧光焦点检测
items.summary_zh: BARseq能够对完整组织进行空间分辨的基因表达谱分析，但其灵敏度取决于对密集荧光rolonies的准确检测和解码。现有spot-calling方法在信号重叠处可能偏保守，而监督深度学习则受限于真实组织图像中缺乏可靠的人工真值。这里我们提出PhySeqNet，一个用于BARseq中无需标注的荧光焦点检测的物理信息深度学习框架。PhySeqNet完全在与仪器匹配的光学模型结合真实无样本实验噪声生成的半合成图像上训练U-Net检测器，并集成到pyBARseq中，这是一个用于BARseq分析的模块化Python流程。PhySeqNet在留出的模拟数据上跨波长波段取得了高检测性能。在无法获得真值的真实组织图像上，我们通过前向模型重建评估检测：PhySeqNet结合保守的条形码感知非极大值抑制（NMSB）在重建保真度（NCC和MS-SSIM）上高于BarDensr单次估计器、调优的经典spot检测器

extra.description: BARseq enables spatially resolved gene-expression profiling across intact tissue, but its sensitivity depends on accurate detection and decoding of dense fluorescent rolonies. Existing spot-calling approaches can be conservative where signals overlap, while supervised deep learning is limited by the lack of reliable manual ground truth in real tissue images. Here we present PhySeqNet, a physics-informed deep learning framework for annotation-free fluorescent foci detection in BARseq. PhySeqNet trains U-Net detectors entirely on semi-synthetic images generated from an instrument-matched optical model combined with real sample-free experimental noise, and is integrated into pyBARseq, a modular Python pipeline for BARseq analysis. PhySeqNet achieved high detection performance on held-out simulated data across wavelength bands. On real tissue images, where ground truth is unavailable, we evaluated detections by forward-model reconstruction: PhySeqNet with conservative barcode-aware non-maxima suppression (NMSB) achieved higher reconstruction fidelity (NCC and MS-SSIM) than the BarDensr single-shot estimator, tuned classical spot detectors, and a pretrained deep-learning detector. In the analyzed brain section, PhySeqNet with NMSB yielded a median of 51 counts per cell versus 47 for BarDensr, with a similar number of genes detected per cell. The recovered transcripts produced spatial expression patterns qualitatively consistent with Allen MERFISH reference data and preserved cell-type composition after scANVI label transfer. These results show that physics-informed simulation can train practical, annotation-free detectors that improve BARseq sensitivity without disrupting downstream biological interpretation.

items.title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
items.title_zh: Truecell 在 Python 生态中原生复现 R Seurat 的单细胞分析输出
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要使用 Seurat（R）或 Scanpy（Python），选择通常由编程语言偏好驱动。然而，默认情况下，这些工具产生不同的可变特征、邻居图、聚类和标记基因。需要 Python（支持大多数深度学习、基础模型和代理工具）的实验室必须在无法复现 Seurat 结果的框架中重新实现 Seurat 分析。Truecell 被开发为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名称、参数、默认设置和对象模型，以促进分析的无缝转移。在十八个与 R Seurat 的配对端到端评估中，确定性输出匹配到浮点精度，并且折叠变化顺序在所有九个差异表达测试中相同。在三个数据集上的三臂基准测试中，固定用户参数和每个工具 20 个种子，Truecell 在所有 12 个数据集和分辨率设置组合中比配置 Seurat 的 Scanpy 更接近地复现 Seurat 的聚类。Truecell

extra.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

items.title: CellMSA: Context Modeling for Single-Cell Representation Learning
items.title_zh: CellMSA：用于单细胞表示学习的上下文建模
items.summary_zh: 单细胞转录组学能够以前所未有的分辨率分析细胞状态，但其高维性、稀疏性和技术批次效应对表示学习构成重大挑战。现有单细胞基础模型通常独立编码每个细胞，或仅对同一批次细胞建模以去噪，从而未充分利用跨批次和细胞类型的丰富关系信息来建模基因表达模式。我们认为，单细胞模型可以从更具信息量的细胞上下文建模中受益。通过比较细胞之间的一致性和变异，模型可以捕捉与细胞状态相关的细粒度基因–基因依赖关系，这对于学习高质量表示至关重要。受蛋白质建模中多序列比对（MSA）上下文使用的启发，我们提出CellMSA，一个将MSA启发式归纳偏置引入转录组建模的单细胞表示学习框架。对于每个目标细胞，CellMSA从不同批次和生物学相关细胞类型中检索相关细胞作为上下文，并将跨细胞模式总结为上下文依赖的基因对表示。然后将该表示注入成对感知的目标细胞编码器，以进行细粒度表示学习。我们在约1.09亿个细胞观测（包括6560万个主要

extra.description: Single-cell transcriptomics enables profiling of cellular states at unprecedented resolution, but its high dimensionality, sparsity, and technical batch effects pose significant challenges for representation learning. Existing single-cell foundation models typically encode each cell independently or only model cells from the same batch for denoising, thereby underutilizing the rich relational information across batches and cell types to model gene expression patterns. We argue that single-cell models can benefit from more informative cell-context modeling. By comparing consistency and variation across cells, models can capture fine-grained gene-gene dependencies associated with cell states, which are essential for learning high-quality representations. Inspired by the use of multiple sequence alignment (MSA) context in protein modeling, we propose CellMSA, a single-cell representation learning framework that introduces an MSA-inspired inductive bias into transcriptomic modeling. For each target cell, CellMSA retrieves relevant cells from different batches and biologically related cell types as context, and summarizes cross-cell patterns into a context-dependent gene-pair representation. This representation is then injected into a pair-aware target-cell encoder for fine-grained representation learning. We pretrain CellMSA on a large-scale human single-cell corpus of approximately 109 million cell observations, including 65.6 million primary observations. Experiments show that our framework consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at the following repository: https://github.com/PharMolix/CellMSA.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: Epigenome Alterations and 3D Chromatin Architecture Remodeling in Inflammatory Macrophage Activation under Diabetic Conditions
items.title_zh: 糖尿病条件下炎症性巨噬细胞激活中的表观基因组改变和3D染色质结构重塑
items.summary_zh: 糖尿病中异常的单核/巨噬细胞激活驱动慢性炎症和糖尿病并发症。尽管表观遗传机制被认为参与这些过程，但三维（3D）染色质重组的贡献仍不清楚。这里，我们使用整合多组学方法，对暴露于高糖和TNF-（HT）、模拟糖尿病环境的人CD14单核细胞来源巨噬细胞中的基因表达、染色质可及性和3D染色质结构进行谱分析。HT诱导的炎症转录程序重现了糖尿病中观察到的程序，并动态重塑染色质可及性、增强子-启动子相互作用和拓扑关联域。炎症基因表现出染色质可及性增加，而细胞周期和代谢基因则表现出可及性降低和增强子-启动子相互作用减弱。这些结构变化促进谱系决定和信号依赖转录因子在增强子-启动子环处汇聚，生成不同的调控枢纽以协调促炎反应。在糖尿病患者外周血来源单核细胞中也观察到类似的增强子-启动子相互作用。此外，通过CRISPR干扰靶向HT诱导增强子来扰动染色质相互作用，会抑制附近的CCL2和其他趋化因子基因。总之，这张糖尿

extra.description: Aberrant monocyte/macrophage activation in diabetes drives chronic inflammation and diabetic complications. Although epigenetic mechanisms are implicated in these processes, the contribution of three-dimensional (3D) chromatin reorganization remains unclear. Here, we use integrated multi-omics approaches to profile gene expression, chromatin accessibility and 3D chromatin architecture in human CD14 monocyte-derived macrophages exposed to high glucose and TNF- (HT), mimicking the diabetic milieu. HT induces inflammatory transcription programs that recapitulate those observed in diabetes and dynamically remodel chromatin accessibility, enhancer-promoter interactions, and topologically associated domains. Inflammatory genes exhibit increased chromatin accessibility, whereas cell cycle and metabolic genes display reduced accessibility and weakened enhancer-promoter interactions. These architectural changes promote the convergence of lineage-determining and signal-dependent transcription factors at enhancer-promoter loops, generating distinct regulatory hubs that orchestrate pro-inflammatory responses. Similar enhancer-promoter interactions are observed in peripheral blood derived monocytes from individuals with diabetes. Furthermore, perturbing chromatin interactions via CRISPR interference targeting HT-induced enhancers suppresses nearby CCL2 and other chemokine genes. Collectively, this first comprehensive enhancer connectome map of macrophages under diabetic conditions advances the field by revealing extensive disease-associated rewiring of the 3D epigenome, highlighting chromatin architecture and epigenetic mechanisms as potential therapeutic target for diabetes-associated inflammation.

items.title: Integrative Multi-omics Analysis of the Human Skeletal Muscle Response to Endurance or Resistance Exercise: Findings from the Molecular Transducers of Physical Activity Consortium (MoTrPAC)
items.title_zh: 人类骨骼肌对耐力或抗阻运动反应的综合多组学分析：来自身体活动分子转导联盟（MoTrPAC）的发现
items.summary_zh: 身体活动分子转导联盟（MoTrPAC）的建立旨在系统刻画运动健康益处的分子基础。这里，我们展示人类骨骼肌对急性耐力（EE）和抗阻（RE）运动的整合多组学反应。观察到不同的时间反应，ATAC-seq、磷酸化蛋白质组和代谢组的变化先于转录组和蛋白质组变化。这些不同的时间多组学动态用于识别围绕MEF2A和NFIC调控自噬、血管生成和代谢汇聚的转录调控枢纽。此外，早期RE特异性磷酸化蛋白质组特征抵消了表观遗传修饰，并下调了参与蛋白质周转的转录本。其他发现包括与急性运动调控肌节蛋白TTN、NEB、ANKRD2和LMOD2相关的HIPK2/3激酶特征受到抑制。我们的数据表明，人类骨骼肌多组学景观存在不同的时间调控，EE和RE引发共同和独特的分子特征。

extra.description: The Molecular Transducers of Physical Activity Consortium (MoTrPAC) was established to systematically characterize the molecular basis of the health benefits of exercise. Here, we present the integrative, multi-omics response of human skeletal muscle to acute endurance (EE) and resistance (RE) exercise. Distinct temporal responses were observed, with changes in ATAC-seq, phosphoproteome, and metabolome occurring before changes in the transcriptome and proteome. These distinct temporal multi-omic dynamics were used to identify transcriptional regulatory hubs converging around MEF2A and NFIC regulation of autophagy, angiogenesis and metabolism. Further, early RE-specific phosphoproteome signatures counteracted epigenetic modifications and downregulated transcripts involved in protein turnover. Additional findings include suppression of HIPK2/3 kinase signatures linked to the acute exercise regulation of sarcomeric proteins TTN, NEB, ANKRD2 and LMOD2. Our data demonstrate distinct temporal regulation across the multi-omic landscape of human skeletal muscle, with EE and RE eliciting common and unique molecular signatures.

items.title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
items.title_zh: CircuitATLAS：在系统神经科学知识图谱上进行代理推理以发现 circuitopathies 中的靶点
items.summary_zh: 神经疾病药物发现传统上聚焦于疾病改变的分子。但导致病理的分子未必是逆转病理的最佳切入点。在此，我们追问哪些原本未被改变的分子控制点可以被用来将病理神经环路恢复至功能状态。我们提出CircuitATLAS，一个基于溯源的系统神经科学知识图谱和智能体框架，用于环路病中的靶点发现。它结构化地整合了来自文献的跨疾病、表型、电生理、环路、脑区、细胞类型和分子效应器的关系，同时刻意排除直接的疾病-基因和疾病-蛋白边以减少捷径推理。该图谱包含383万个节点和766万条边，其中包括531万条LLM提取的关系，并整合了人类细胞图谱等结构化数据集和新的多模态在体测量。随后我们引入一个智能体工作流，从可测量的疾病表型出发，经由其环路和细胞基质，推理至分子干预、治疗可行性和临床约束。最后，我们引入一个人工治理的在体实验室在环，将假设生成与实验迭代连接起来。在该框架内，一个智能体提名ATP1A3——神经元alpha

extra.description: Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: BaseCamp --- An Agentic AI Framework for Automating DNA Sequencing Data Pipelines
items.title_zh: BaseCamp --- 一种用于自动化 DNA 测序数据流程的智能体 AI 框架
items.summary_zh: DNA 测序流程，涵盖质量控制、比对、变异检测和注释，如今已由工作流管理系统可靠执行，这些系统大规模编排成熟的生物信息学工具。仍然依赖人工的是围绕该执行的决策层：选择适合样本和平台的质量阈值、裁定边界变异检测、诊断异常，以及确定哪些发现值得专家审查。这些决策重复、判断密集、在不同操作者之间不一致，且常常未被记录。本文介绍 BaseCamp，一种用于自动化 DNA 测序流程决策层的新型智能体 AI 框架。该框架将流程分解为六个专门 AI 智能体，涵盖样本接收和质量控制、比对、变异检测、注释、跨阶段监测和报告。关键的是，BaseCamp 智能体不执行序列分析：成熟工具执行比对、检测和注释，而智能体在其中选择、配置、解释其输出并决定后续步骤。这将语言模型推理限制在其可靠的判断层，并保留现有工具保证的可重复性。智能体推理由一个经过微调、领域专门化的大型语言模型联盟驱动，由中央推理 LLM 协调，在

extra.description: DNA sequencing pipelines, spanning quality control, alignment, variant calling, and annotation, are now reliably executed by workflow management systems that orchestrate established bioinformatics tools at scale. What remains manual is the decision layer surrounding that execution: selecting quality thresholds appropriate to a sample and platform, adjudicating borderline variant calls, diagnosing anomalies, and determining which findings warrant expert review. These decisions are repetitive, judgment-intensive, inconsistent across operators, and frequently undocumented. This paper introduces BaseCamp, a novel agentic AI framework for automating the decision layer of DNA sequencing pipelines. The framework decomposes the pipeline into six specialized AI agents, covering sample intake and quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, cross-stage monitoring, and reporting. Critically, BaseCamp agents do not perform sequence analysis: established tools execute alignment, calling, and annotation, while the agents select among them, configure them, interpret their output, and decide what follows. This confines language model reasoning to the judgment layer where it is reliable and preserves the reproducibility existing tooling guarantees. Agent reasoning is powered by a consortium of fine-tuned, domain-specialized large language models coordinated by a central reasoning LLM, executing locally so no sequencing data leaves the operating environment, under human-in-the-loop orchestration. Evaluation shows agent-generated configurations are concordant with expert practice, that an explicit filtering ledger renders inspectable what filtering otherwise removes without trace, and that cross-stage anomaly detection surfaces conditions execution monitoring misses. BaseCamp offers a generalizable blueprint for agentic automation of scientific data pipelines.

items.title: Orchestra: Corroboration-Based Regulatory Candidate Discovery via Composed Bioinformatics MCP Agents
items.title_zh: Orchestra：通过组合生物信息学MCP智能体进行基于佐证的调控候选发现
items.summary_zh: Orchestra将两个独立构建的生物信息学MCP服务器——RegNetAgents（从ARACNe网络推断基因调控网络拓扑）和CASCADE（提供四个独立证据源：LINCS敲低、DepMap必需性、超级增强子状态、DoRothEA转录因子置信度）——组合成一个通过模型上下文协议暴露的多智能体工作流。其核心架构主张是，要求RegNetAgents的拓扑证据和CASCADE的实验证据在候选调控因子上达成一致，比任一单独来源产生更可信的候选——此前未直接测试，因为RegNetAgents自身的验证仅询问其候选列表是否优于随机。我们在TCGA肿瘤获得性调控因子层级（基因肿瘤ARACNe网络中但不在GREmLN群体平均基线中的调控因子）上测试，通过ARACNe互信息（MI）边权重选择候选。在RegNetAgents已发表的BRCA/COAD焦点基因面板及匹配阴性对照上，CASCADE 4个来源中至

extra.description: Orchestra composes two independently built bioinformatics MCP servers -- RegNetAgents, which infers gene regulatory network topology from ARACNe networks, and CASCADE, which supplies four independent evidence sources (LINCS knockdown, DepMap essentiality, super-enhancer status, DoRothEA transcription-factor confidence) -- into one multi-agent workflow exposed via the Model Context Protocol. Its central architectural claim is that requiring RegNetAgents' topology evidence and CASCADE's experimental evidence to agree on a candidate regulator yields a more trustworthy candidate than either alone -- not previously tested directly, since RegNetAgents' own validation asked only whether its candidate lists beat chance. We test this on the TCGA tumor-acquired regulator tier (regulators in a gene's tumor ARACNe network but absent from the GREmLN population-averaged baseline), selecting candidates by ARACNe mutual-information (MI) edge weight. On RegNetAgents' published BRCA/COAD focal-gene panel plus matched negative controls, agreement among at least 2 of the 4 CASCADE sources predicts OncoKB cancer-gene status among focal genes (odds ratio 2.89, Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted p=0.0166) but not among negative controls (p=0.0721); a single source is not diagnostic for either group. The pattern replicates and strengthens in a third cancer type, STAD, on a separately constructed panel (odds ratio 5.82), and against an independently curated ground truth (the Sanger COSMIC Cancer Gene Census). MI edge weight is the strongest single predictor overall (p=0.0003); a logistic-regression likelihood-ratio test confirms corroboration adds value beyond it in both panels (p=0.0234; p=0.0001). Every experiment invokes Orchestra's real agentic entry point.

items.title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
items.title_zh: 语言模型能玩维基百科游戏吗？
items.summary_zh: 语言模型越来越多地支持或自动化从大到无法索引的文档集合中进行信息检索。当任务需要专业语言或科学知识时，这一任务很困难。我们使用维基百科游戏在类似的信息检索任务上测试语言模型。在游戏中，玩家必须仅使用文章链接到达目标文章。我们比较了句子嵌入模型和LLM在五种维基百科语言和五个学术文献数据集上的表现。我们使用OpenAlex构建非常大的维基百科页面和论文引用本地图，并提供构建和导航它们的代码。这使得无需依赖第三方API即可研究语言模型的导航能力。我们将模型与人类和TF-IDF基准进行比较。维基百科游戏格式支持跨技术、语言和领域的稳健比较。没有模型显著优于人类，尽管最佳模型（GPT-o3 mini、GPT-4o、QwQ:32B和DeepSeek-R1:70B）取得了相当的成功。性能和排名因语言和主题而异，这对使用这些技术的实践者具有启示。

extra.description: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.

items.title: Revisiting Tabular Deep Regression: Objectives and the Limits of Global Early Stopping
items.title_zh: 重新审视表格深度回归：目标函数与全局早停的局限
items.summary_zh: 尽管表格数据深度学习模型最近受到显著研究关注，但回归任务目标函数的选择仍是一个研究不足的自由度。多条研究路线提供了标准均方误差（MSE）的替代方案，但数据集、骨干网络和评估协议的差异使其实际收益难以比较。在这项工作中，我们通过对广泛既有表格数据集和多种神经骨干网络进行回归目标的系统重新评估来填补这一空白。我们的比较表明，许多提出的目标相对于适当调优的MSE基线仅提供有限或不一致的增益，而分位数损失在测试骨干网络上相对MSE产生一致的总体改进。然后我们识别出即使使用这一强目标仍然存在的局限：具有不同目标噪声水平的区域可能在不同训练轮次达到最佳预测性能。因此，即使目标能够表示异方差目标分布，单一全局早停检查点也会在不同不确定性区域之间施加折中。受此局限启发，我们引入分位数损失的异方差感知扩展，使用输入依赖标签平滑作为潜在补救，并在多个骨干网络上优于分位数损失。总体而言，我们的结果为表格深度学习

extra.description: While deep learning models for tabular data have recently received significant research attention, the choice of objective functions for regression tasks remains an understudied degree of freedom. Several lines of research offer alternatives to the standard Mean Squared Error (MSE), but differences in datasets, backbones, and evaluation protocols make their practical benefits difficult to compare. In this work, we address this gap by performing a systematic re-evaluation of regression objectives across a broad collection of established tabular datasets and multiple neural backbones. Our comparison reveals that many proposed objectives provide limited or inconsistent gains over a properly tuned MSE baseline, while quantile loss yields consistent aggregate improvements over MSE across the tested backbones. We then identify a limitation that remains even with this strong objective: regions with different levels of target noise can reach their best predictive performance at different training epochs. Consequently, a single global early-stopping checkpoint can impose a compromise between uncertainty regions, even when the objective can represent heteroskedastic target distributions. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce a heteroskedasticity-aware extension of quantile loss that uses input-dependent label smoothing as a potential remedy and improves over quantile loss on several backbones. Overall, our results provide a modern empirical picture of regression objectives for tabular deep learning and highlight how differences in optimal stopping times across uncertainty regions can limit the effectiveness of global early stopping. The code is available at https://github.com/yandex-research/tabular-regression.

items.title: Task Context Shapes Component Roles in Language Models
items.title_zh: 任务上下文塑造语言模型中的组件角色
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型在不同任务中复用相同的注意力头，但识别这些共享头并不能解释它们在每个任务中不同做什么。一个自然的灵感来源是共享脑区之间任务依赖的相互作用，这激发了语言模型计算的网络视角。这里，我们使用相同的图事实——指定哪些有向连接存在的陈述——比较跨任务的固定模型组件。我们测量干预如何影响注意力头和后续层中的激活状态（影响），以及答案（重要性）。任务变化在五个开放权重模型、四个家族和1.5-14亿参数中重新分配影响。在Gemma-2-9B和Qwen3-14B中，激活编辑改变早期内部激活向量，并在书面指令保持不变时切换模型读取的事实。相同的头随后响应不同的图事实，并以不同方式影响后续组件。对于每个提示，我们构建两个线性响应图，一个在编辑前，一个在编辑后。每个图从早期头的测量变化预测后续头的响应。对于单独的事实干预，相应条件的图相比两个图的平均值，在Gemma中将均方预测误差降低53.6%，在Q

extra.description: Large language models reuse the same attention heads across tasks, but identifying these shared heads does not explain what they do differently in each task. A natural source of inspiration is task-dependent interactions among shared brain regions, which motivate a network view of language-model computation. Here, we compare fixed model components across tasks using identical graph facts, statements specifying which directed connections are present. We measure how interventions affect attention heads and the activation state in later layers (influence), as well as the answer (importance). Task changes redistribute the influence in five open-weight models spanning four families and 1.5-14 billion parameters. In Gemma-2-9B and Qwen3-14B, an activation edit changes an early internal activation vector and switches which fact the model reads while the written instruction stays fixed. The same heads then respond to different graph facts and influence later components differently. For each prompt, we construct two linear response maps, one before the edit and one after it. Each map predicts a later head's response from a measured change in an earlier head. For a separate factual intervention, the map for the corresponding condition reduces mean squared prediction error by 53.6% in Gemma and 5.0% in Qwen compared with the average of the two maps. These findings show that task context changes both which graph facts the shared components respond to and how their outputs affect later computation. A network account may help explain how models use shared parameters to perform different computations. Measurements of task-dependent influence could also guide interventions intended to alter one behavior while preserving others.

items.title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
items.title_zh: RATED：通过执行动态实现可靠性感知的AI智能体工具检索
items.summary_zh: 随着AI智能体越来越依赖外部工具，准确检索对可靠行为至关重要。现有方法优化语义相关性，但在很大程度上忽略执行期间的工具可用性。为填补这一空白，我们提出RATED（通过执行动态实现可靠性感知工具检索），一个结合稳健语义匹配与动态可靠性适配的检索框架。RATED采用冻结双编码器并通过对比微调进行语义匹配，以及一个轻量级上下文bandit模块，根据实时执行反馈对候选重新排序。这种设计能够快速适应运行时工具故障，而无需昂贵的模型重训练。我们引入EcoAgent，一个包含5,172个真实世界工具和超过210,000个查询-工具对的基准，用于离线检索和动态可靠性评估。实验结果表明，RATED在真实世界查询上相比ToolLLM API检索器实现52.2%的相对MRR提升，并在30%失败率的严重API中断场景下将故障选择率从86.2%降至2.9%，同时相比仅编码推理产生可忽略的低于1 ms延迟开销。代码和

extra.description: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.

items.title: Prediction Is Not a Sufficient Memory State
items.title_zh: 预测不是充分的记忆状态
items.summary_zh: 一个能重现每个当前预测的记忆，可能仍然忘记了如何从下一个观测中学习。我们针对精确累积学习和注意力刻画这一区别。对于具有无限制实特征和标签的光滑凸残差损失，固定维度的连续循环状态存在当且仅当损失为多项式。对于普通、未加权观测，次数$D$需要恰好$r=\binom{d+D}{D}-1$个坐标；即使在具有一个固定当前预测器的历史中，也恰好有$r-d$个坐标可能对继续学习仍然必要。非多项式损失在此类等预测历史上具有无界需求。有界标量逻辑示例在固定任意有限导数 jet 后仍保留这一障碍。对于岭回归，隐藏证据是设计矩阵：精确状态成本为$dp+d(d+1)/2$，而预测器为$dp$。在一个良条件零预测族上，最优$B$比特压缩的平均单次更新误差为$d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}$量级，$s_d=d(d+1)/2$，即使使用任意随机编码。核注意力给出第二个精确闭包分类。这些结果识别未来更新揭示了什么，而

extra.description: A memory that reproduces every current prediction may still have forgotten how to learn from the next observation. We characterize this distinction for exact cumulative learning and attention. For smooth convex residual losses with unrestricted real features and labels, a continuous recurrent state of fixed dimension exists exactly when the loss is polynomial. With ordinary, unweighted observations, degree $D$ requires precisely $r=\binom{d+D}{D}-1$ coordinates; even among histories with one fixed current predictor, exactly $r-d$ coordinates can remain necessary for continuation. Nonpolynomial losses have unbounded requirements on such equal-prediction histories. Bounded scalar logistic examples retain this obstruction after fixing any finite derivative jet. For ridge regression, the hidden evidence is the design matrix: the exact state costs $dp+d(d+1)/2$, versus $dp$ for the predictor. On a well-conditioned zero-prediction family, optimal $B$-bit compression has average one-update error of order $d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}$, $s_d=d(d+1)/2$, even with arbitrary randomized codes. Kernel attention gives a second exact closure classification. The results identify what future updates reveal, rather than proposing a new regression algorithm or asserting trained-model gains.

items.title: SLICE: Sequential Likelihood-Free Inference via Conformal E-Values
items.title_zh: SLICE：通过共形E值的序列无似然推断
items.summary_zh: 许多科学模型可以模拟但似然不可处理，使频率派不确定性量化困难。我们为此类模型参数构建精确的随时有效置信序列。在每个观测处，来自每个候选零假设的新模拟将正可预测得分共形化为条件e值；它们的乘积是检验鞅，我们在参数上将其反演。有效性对任何此类得分成立，无论其准确性如何。我们表明，oracle似然比得分最大化期望对数增长，这促使我们用摊销神经比率估计器近似它。在合成基准、LLM API中模型路由审计和微引力透镜数据上，所得置信序列在连续监测下保持有效，而固定样本方法则不能，神经得分与精确似然比和应用特定得分相比仍具竞争力。

extra.description: Many scientific models can be simulated but have intractable likelihoods, making frequentist uncertainty quantification difficult. We construct exact anytime-valid confidence sequences for the parameters of such models. At each observation, fresh simulations from each candidate null conformalize a positive predictable score into a conditional e-value; their product is a test martingale, which we invert over the parameter. Validity holds for any such score, whatever its accuracy. We show that the oracle likelihood-ratio score maximizes expected log growth, which motivates approximating it with an amortized neural ratio estimator. On synthetic benchmarks, an audit of model routing in an LLM API, and microlensing data, the resulting confidence sequences stay valid under continuous monitoring, where fixed-sample methods do not, and neural scores remain competitive with exact likelihood ratios and application-specific scores.

items.title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
items.title_zh: SpatialASM：内化主动心理化以进行空间推理
items.summary_zh: 在解决复杂空间推理任务时，普通人会自然地从任务相关视角重新审视场景，并从这些视角在心理上重建空间布局。但大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）能主动以同样方式思考吗？我们将这种能力称为主动空间心理化（ASM），它是视觉智能的内在组成部分，但在当前LVLM中仍显著欠发达。为弥合这一差距，我们引入SpatialASM，一个通过训练时空间模拟将ASM内化到LVLM的可扩展框架。SpatialASM采用异中心新视角生成器，将假设视角 grounding 到视觉证据中，并产生两种互补形式的监督：i）显式ASM轨迹，教LVLM在空间推理期间何时以及如何自适应地调用视角规划和想象；ii）自动构建的视角采择任务，进一步增强视角条件场景想象。在七个基准上，从相对感知导向的空间理解到需要多图像、跨视角和视角变换推理的更具挑战性任务，SpatialASM在四个LVLM骨干上提升空间推理性能，同时保留其原始通用视觉能力。实

extra.description: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.

items.title: 如何看待「理记」发文称将在 20 至 40 天内退出所有自媒体平台，彻底停止内容更新？
items.title_zh: 如何看待「理记」发文称将在 20 至 40 天内退出所有自媒体平台，彻底停止内容更新？
items.summary_zh: 10月12日消息，今日，大V“理记”发文官宣全面退网计划，称将在20至40天内（最早下月初、最迟下月底）退出所有自媒体平台，彻底停止内容更新。 理记表示，此次退网为彻底离场，将卸载全部自媒体相关APP，不再更新任何平台账号。后续其微博仅会在必要情况下，由朋友代为发布少量通报内容，全年或无更新、或仅有数次更新，本人将彻底淡出互联网舆论场。 谈及退网核心原因，理记坦言自身已丧失自媒体创作与发声的欲望，多年深耕自媒体领域后，已完成个人精神价值追求，如同游戏通关，已然“燃尽自我”，无任何遗憾。同时，自身存在克制不住关注网络争议、忍不住发声的个人特质，十年反复如此且已确诊相关问题，长期身处舆论场极易放大自身风险。 理记透露，自身无生活与变现压力，无需依靠自媒体盈利谋生，也不缺失现实社会认同，当下更追求纯粹的自我生活与内心自由，不愿为流量、名利让自身变得功利与尖锐。他表示，自媒体属于更有热血、有欲望的

items.title: 沙特利雅得机场再次遇袭造成1死11伤，胡塞武装称也门萨那国际机场也遭沙特袭击，双方冲突会持续升级吗？
items.title_zh: 沙特利雅得机场再次遇袭造成1死11伤，胡塞武装称也门萨那国际机场也遭沙特袭击，双方冲突会持续升级吗？
items.summary_zh: 当地时间10月12日，沙特阿拉伯民航总局就11日下午利雅得哈立德国王国际机场再次遭袭事件发布补充声明。 声明称，此次袭击造成1名巴基斯坦籍居民死亡，另有11人受伤。伤者已被立即送往医院接受治疗。 当天稍早，沙特民航总局发布声明称，当天下午首都利雅得哈立德国王国际机场再次遭到袭击，袭击已造成人员受伤。声明称，目前沙特有关部门正在协调对机场受损情况进行评估，并对机场设施安全状况进行检查。沙特民航总局：11日利雅得机场再次遇袭造成1死11伤 当地时间10月11日，沙特阿拉伯主导的多国联军发言人图尔基·马利基发布消息称，一枚不明投射物袭击了沙特首都利雅得哈立德国王国际机场4号旅客航站楼，袭击引发火灾，目前相关地点正由主管部门处置。 △多国联军发言人图尔基·马利基（资料图） 随后，沙特主导联军表示，部署在哈立德国王国际机场周边的防空系统拦截并摧毁了一枚巡航导弹。 △沙特利雅得近期画面（资料图） 沙特

items.title: 周鸿祎攀岩从 3 米高处摔下，左膝粉碎性骨折，攀岩有哪些易被忽视的风险？攀岩时需要做好哪些防护？
items.title_zh: 周鸿祎攀岩从 3 米高处摔下，左膝粉碎性骨折，攀岩有哪些易被忽视的风险？攀岩时需要做好哪些防护？
items.summary_zh: 10月11日，周鸿祎发视频称，10日进行抱石攀岩时，不慎从约3米高处坠落，造成左膝粉碎性骨折。 据周鸿祎介绍，其在三米左右高度的抱石攀岩过程中失手坠落，落地瞬间，他未能做出正确缓冲落地动作，左腿单独承受全部冲击，“我当场听到左膝盖发出‘咔嚓’一声响，左腿就动不了了。” 周鸿祎表示，受伤情影响，未来两三个月内，所有出差、外出活动都将取消，近期一个月需要在家佩戴固定器静养，相关行程全部调整。 他还感慨，极限攀岩类运动对年长人群存在不小的意外风险，“我有点后怕。”周鸿祎攀岩从3米高处摔下，左膝粉碎性骨折，“听到膝盖咔嚓一响，有点后怕”，未来两三个月，出差、外出活动取消

items.title: 特朗普称俄乌冲突进入「能源停火」状态，泽连斯基称支持，乌武装部队已收到命令，意味着什么？
items.title_zh: 特朗普称俄乌冲突进入「能源停火」状态，泽连斯基称支持，乌武装部队已收到命令，意味着什么？
items.summary_zh: 美国总统特朗普11日在社交媒体发文称，即刻起，俄乌冲突进入“能源停火”状态，双方均已同意。 乌克兰总统泽连斯基当地时间10月11日表示，乌克兰“支持切实可行、可靠的停火和结束战争的方式”，乌方“愿意不对俄罗斯能源设施发动打击，并期待俄罗斯采取同样行动”。 他表示，美国总统特朗普已宣布达成能源停火安排，乌方对此表示欢迎，并希望这一安排能够真正落实。 泽连斯基还说，乌克兰武装部队已收到相关命令。乌方正等待美国与俄罗斯对话的具体细节，并期待俄罗斯总统普京履行特朗普所说的相关承诺。 特朗普：俄乌双方同意“能源停火” 泽连斯基称支持“能源停火” 乌武装部队已收到相关命令

items.title: 知名数码博主疑爆料华为将推出新品牌「星芒」，消息靠谱吗？华为为何在此时选择推子品牌？
items.title_zh: 知名数码博主疑爆料华为将推出新品牌「星芒」，消息靠谱吗？华为为何在此时选择推子品牌？
items.summary_zh: 10月12日消息，昨日，数码圈爆料华为有望推出全新手机子品牌，命名为星芒。 爆料称，星芒定位对标早年荣耀，主打1799至4000元中端性价比市场，预计今年11月亮相首款机型。传闻该系列将搭载麒麟8系芯片+原生鸿蒙系统，下放XMAGE影像，舍弃卫星通信等高端旗舰配置，主打普惠向鸿蒙+麒麟体验。 对此，据北京商报消息，华为相关人士称请以官方信息为准。 据天眼查信息显示，华为技术有限公司已于2023年2月1日申请注册“华为星芒”商标，国际分类涵盖09类-科学仪器、14类-珠宝钟表、35类-广告销售、42类-网站服务，注册公告日期为2023年9月14日，目前商标状态均为已注册。 华为回应将推手机子品牌「星芒」：一切以官方信息为准_注册_鸿蒙_麒麟华为回应将推手机子品牌「星芒」：一切以官方信息为准

items.title: 儿科医生按号顺序抢救车祸重伤儿童，后一位家长插队被拒后打电话投诉，此事背后反映了哪些问题？
items.title_zh: 儿科医生按号顺序抢救车祸重伤儿童，后一位家长插队被拒后打电话投诉，此事背后反映了哪些问题？
items.summary_zh: 一个儿科医生正在抢救车祸重伤的孩子，门外家长要求插队，说自家孩子“血流不止”。医生看了一眼，敷料是干结的。医生说：请等叫号。家长当场拨了投诉电话。10月9日，苏州大学附属儿童医院医生陈世赓接诊时遇到这一幕。他当时叫号的患儿是车祸伤，病情更重。要求插队的患儿伤口敷料干结，并非大出血。医生判断不紧急，让家长等待。家长不满所以投诉。当天陈医生接诊105人。最终投诉未成立，家长道歉，孩子也完成诊断。 这位投诉医生的家长有一个认知误区：急诊不是先来后到，也不是谁闹谁有理。急诊按病情分级，急危重症优先。车祸伤、大出血、意识不清，这些是真正需要抢时间的。伤口已经干结、孩子生命体征平稳，属于非紧急情况，排在后面是合理的。但更值得追问的是：当医生坚持分诊规则，却因此要面对投诉，他下一次还敢不敢坚持？投诉是患者的权利，但仅因插队被拒就投诉，是用投诉施压，逼迫医生放弃专业判断，挤占医生救命的时间。 患者、患者家

items.title: 我国验证出一种全新抗癌疗法，一针纳米材料打进肿瘤可让癌细胞生锈死亡，原理是什么？这一成果具有哪些意义？
items.title_zh: 我国验证出一种全新抗癌疗法，一针纳米材料打进肿瘤可让癌细胞生锈死亡，原理是什么？这一成果具有哪些意义？
items.summary_zh: 极目新闻记者 李博 通讯员 侯丹丹 刘晓 论文部分页面截图 打一针，让癌细胞“生锈”而死——这一抗癌新思路，我国科学家已率先开展临床验证。10月9日，记者从恩施州中心医院获悉，四川大学华西医院与该院联合开展的全球首个铁死亡诱导剂人体I期临床试验结果，近日在医学顶级期刊《Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy》公布。结果表明，我国研发的新一代纳米药物“纳米炭铁”注入肿瘤后，能诱导癌细胞铁死亡，18例受试者整体疾病控制率达到84.2%。 什么是“铁死亡”？恩施州中心医院黄楚鹰博士打了个形象的比方：如果普通细胞死亡是“停电”，那铁死亡就像是让癌细胞内部“生锈”了——铁离子让癌细胞里的油脂酸败、氧化，最后彻底崩溃。这种疗法主要针对肿瘤本身，对免疫系统破坏较小，被国内外医学界视为攻克实体肿瘤的新希望。 过去二十多年，实验室里发现了大量能诱导铁死亡的化合物，但
